_: THE FLOAT'S CONTENTS (FLOAT.md §10, Osca 28 Sep). The INTERACTIONS are fixed in float.js -- tap W = play/pause, press a band or corner = the fan, drag W = move, drag a side = scrub, drag a corner = resize, drag inward from the border side = HOME. What is IN the fan is this file's, 3 or 4 of the verbs below, in order; the editor's Float page writes it; float.js reads it at open and no code changes when the list changes. speak is a TOGGLE (the mic stays open until pressed again; the red letter breathes while it is). define / explain / translate act on the word showing at the press. frank = home. prevch / nextch = the chapter before / after. pace / sleep = the transport's.
